name: GAN 356 ME 3x3 (Magnetic) - Jurassic World Edition
description: The GAN 356 ME 3x3 (Magnetic) - Jurassic World wraps GAN's trusted beginner-friendly magnetic 3x3 in a licensed theme: earthy brown, jungle green, and signature yellow, with the Jurassic World logo on the center cap and claw-mark detailing. Same smooth, stable magnetic feel GAN built the 356 ME on, dressed for the film.
features: Licensed Jurassic World theme: Brown, green, and yellow color scheme with the Jurassic World logo on the center and claw-mark detailing on the top face.
Magnetic feel out of the box: Positioning magnets help each layer settle into place, so turns line up cleanly and the cube feels controlled.
A great first magnetic cube: The 356 ME is one of GAN's most approachable magnetic 3x3s, built for new cubers and collectors alike.
Collector-friendly: A themed stickerless speed cube that looks as good on a shelf as it does in solve.
Magnetic core system: Magnets provide alignment and stability for more accurate turning.
Stickerless build: Molded plastic colors won't peel or fade with heavy use.
